name: time-range-field
title: Time range field
description: A start and an end time with the length between them: type or pick each end, move the start and the end follows, and a bad range is refused in words.
docs: value and onValueChange speak { start, end, minutes }: start and end are 24-hour "HH:MM" strings and minutes is the length, with the night counted when the end is on the next day. It is reported once both times are set and the range is allowed, and null whenever it is not, so a form never sees half a range. Each end is an input that takes what people type (9, 930, 0930, 9:30, 9h30, 2:30 pm) and a button that opens the same list of slots the Time picker offers, every step minutes from min to max; the end list says how long each choice makes the range, and slots at or before the start are disabled unless allowOvernight is on, when they show the length and +1 day. A range that ends on the next day says +1 day after its length beside the field too. The arrow keys move a time to the next slot on the grid, Alt+ArrowDown opens the list. Times are settled when the field is left, on Enter, on a pick and on an arrow key, never on every keystroke. An end that is not after the start is refused with the reason in words and aria-invalid on the end input; a time outside min and max, or a text that is no time, is explained on its own input. keepDuration moves the end along when the start changes and says so in a polite live region; without allowOvernight the end stops at max. name adds <name>-start and <name>-end hidden inputs, id lands on the start input (the end gets it with -end after it), and name the group with aria-labelledby or aria-label. labels renames every phrase.
